provenance.source: Existing entries include Codex-generated Paimon art from a user-provided reference; coke-refresh was generated by Codex from the existing pen-skin style direction and a Coca-Cola-inspired art brief; voxel-overworld was generated by Codex from a blocky voxel sandbox-inspired art brief; burger-buddy was generated by Codex from a generic hamburger-themed art brief; dragon-ink was generated by Codex from an original ornate golden dragon drawing-pen brief inspired by the mood of classic dragon-themed shooter artwork; infinity-edge uses the existing diagonal windblade pen silhouette as a construction base, then deterministically recolors it to silver steel and an obsidian spine and adds original gold rune inlays plus a red-orange gem after checking the League of Legends Infinity Edge icon references at https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/File:Infinity_Edge_item_HD.png and https://www.millenium.gg/guias/33688.html; no official art was copied; fire-kylin-v4 was generated with the built-in image_gen edit flow from fire-kylin-v3, making the AK47 muzzle itself the single aligned pen tip and tightening the classic AK47 Fire Kylin black-crimson-gold armor and attached qilin head after checking public AK47-火麒麟 references at https://cncf.fandom.com/zh/wiki/AK47-%E7%81%AB%E9%BA%92%E9%BA%97 and https://games.sina.com.cn/o/z/cf/weapon.shtml; it preserves a clear stock, receiver, curved magazine, dragon head, flame channels, and pen nib without official logo, text, or copied weapon image; milk-tea was generated by Codex from an original unbranded bubble-tea drawing-pen brief; snowking-frost was generated by Codex from an original red-white ice-drink and snowman drawing-pen brief inspired by the mood of a user-requested ice-drink brand theme; eva-unit01 was generated by Codex from an original purple-green biomechanical mecha drawing-pen brief inspired by the mood of a user-requested animation reference; wuju-master was generated by Codex from an original Wuju / Master Yi-inspired drawing-pen brief with seven lenses, white hair, and jade-gold armor cues; persona3-blue-hour-v2 was generated by Codex from an original compact midnight-blue fountain-pen brief with moon-phase clock, arcana card, coffin geometry, and Blue Hour cues inspired by the mood of a user-requested Persona 3 theme; dongqin-sea-breeze was generated by Codex from an original collegiate engineering fountain-pen brief with sea waves, compass, campus architecture, and a simplified white-mountain-black-water-and-great-wall crest motif inspired by a user-requested Northeastern University at Qinhuangdao theme; pikachu-thunderbolt was generated by Codex from an original yellow lightning-themed drawing-pen brief with an abstract thunder-sprite charm inspired by a user-requested Pikachu theme; miku-future-echo was generated by Codex from a Hatsune Miku-themed drawing-pen brief using the official Crypton Future Media character presentation as visual reference; teto-crimson-chorus was generated by Codex from a Kasane Teto-themed drawing-pen brief using the official Kasane Teto site and its official illustration page as visual reference; bocchi-lonely-rock was generated by Codex with the built-in image_gen tool from an original diagonal electric-guitar drawing-pen brief inspired by the mood and color language of Bocchi the Rock; it uses pink-blue lacquer, cyan pickups, yellow-blue geometric accents, and no character portrait, official logo, or copied key art; kuuga-mighty-legacy was generated with the built-in image_gen tool from an original diagonal red-black armored fountain-pen brief inspired by the visual mood of Kamen Rider Kuuga Mighty Form after checking Toei's official Kuuga form catalog at https://www.kamen-rider-official.com/zukan/forms/574 and series page at https://www.kamen-rider-official.com/series/kuuga/; it uses a red-black-gold palette, circular crimson transformation-core motif, ancient-glyph accents, and an abstract horned finial without a character body, official logo, or copied key art; whale-maid-tide was generated with the built-in image_gen tool from an original diagonal whale-maid ocean attendant drawing-pen brief based on the user-provided reference palette and motifs (navy/periwinkle, white frills, blue bow, whale emblem and tail); no character portrait, official logo, readable text or copied art was used; luo-tianyi-resonance was generated with the built-in image_gen tool from an original diagonal electronic singer drawing-pen brief based on public Luo Tianyi references: silver-gray twin-tail ribbon language, Tianyi blue #66CCFF, white-blue stage styling, microphone and waveform motifs; the reference sources were the official Luo Tianyi site at https://luotianyi.jp/ and the public reference images returned by image search; no character portrait, official logo, readable text or copied key art was used
provenance.cleanup: scripts/prepare-pen-skin.mjs removes connected light backdrop pixels; scripts/create-infinity-edge-png.mjs performs the deterministic palette pass and attached details; the generated fire-kylin-v4.png was alpha-checked after generation; scripts/create-fire-kylin-png.mjs remains the earlier deterministic draft generator; burger-buddy, dragon-ink, milk-tea, snowking-frost, eva-unit01, wuju-master, persona3-blue-hour, persona3-blue-hour-v2, dongqin-sea-breeze, pikachu-thunderbolt, miku-future-echo, teto-crimson-chorus and infinity-edge were alpha-checked after generation and contain no continuous trail or baked UI text; infinity-edge is a diagonal PNG and fire-kylin-v4 is a diagonal landscape PNG; both keep their reference silhouettes readable at cursor scale; bocchi-lonely-rock was alpha-checked and normalized to 1024x1024 RGBA; kuuga-mighty-legacy was alpha-checked as a transparent 1536x1024 RGBA diagonal asset with a clear nib at lower-left and no baked UI text; whale-maid-tide was alpha-checked as a transparent 1312x1199 RGBA diagonal asset with a clear nib at lower-left and no baked UI text; luo-tianyi-resonance was alpha-checked as a transparent 1222x1287 RGBA diagonal asset with a clear nib at lower-left and no baked UI text
provenance.license: generated game assets for private testing; Paimon reference rights, the Coca-Cola trademark/logo, and any external style or brand references require rights review before public or commercial distribution; infinity-edge is an original fan-inspired design with no Riot or League of Legends logo, text, or copied official artwork; fire-kylin-v4 is an original CrossFire-inspired design with no official logo, text, or copied weapon image; bocchi-lonely-rock is an original fan-inspired design with external reference rights requiring review before public or commercial distribution; kuuga-mighty-legacy is an original fan-inspired design with external reference rights requiring review before public or commercial distribution; whale-maid-tide is an original fan-inspired design with external reference rights requiring review before public or commercial distribution; luo-tianyi-resonance is an original fan-inspired design with external reference rights requiring review before public or commercial distribution
